source: Silverlands Tanzania feed products (silverlandstanzania.net: feed-products, layer-feed, broiler-feed). Photos cut from the site's two combined bag pictures; descriptions written from the facts listed there.

products.name: Broiler Pre-Starter Crumble
products.description:
The first feed in the Silverlands broiler programme, a crumble for chicks in their first week.

Silverlands broiler programme:
• Pre-Starter Crumble: day 0–7
• Starter Crumble: day 8–14
• Grower Pellet: day 15–27
• Finisher Pellet: day 28–42
products.dosage: Feed from day 0 to day 7, then move to Broiler Starter Crumble.

products.name: Broiler Starter Crumble
products.description:
Silverlands broiler starter in crumble form, for the second week of a broiler's life. Silverlands says that with this programme and their broiler chicks, birds can reach about 1.4 kg at 28 days with a feed conversion of about 1.4.

Silverlands broiler programme:
• Pre-Starter Crumble: day 0–7
• Starter Crumble: day 8–14
• Grower Pellet: day 15–27
• Finisher Pellet: day 28–42

Also the first feed (day 0–13) in the Silverlands layer pullet programme.
products.dosage: Broilers: day 8 to 14. Layer pullets: day 0 to 13.
products.keywords: silverlands|broiler starter|starter crumble|chakula cha kuku wa nyama|nyama bora
